agreements: HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are exactly the two on-policy systems; ORIENT and THINK_ACT are mandatory phases of one reconstructed recurrent loop, while adapter-off and binding-shuffled runs are sterile EXPERIENTIAL diagnostics rather than additional agents.

The common canonical packet, public tools, locked acquisition order, capped ledger/notebook/retrieval, logical budgets, reset policy, and SLEEP cadence are whole-system common infrastructure; only EXPERIENTIAL's life-local q/v LoRA is adaptive parameter state across sleep.
Removing anchor, preservation, KL, and auxiliary rows keeps the adapter-off diagnostic a null-adapter comparison rather than a preservation-confounded treatment comparison.

CompilerGym 0.2.5, LLVM 10, and benchmark://poj104-v1 are conditional local candidates. A one-life common-order Stage C can report only exact wiring/recipe feasibility and raw descriptive cells, never causal credit, mechanism, lifetime, superiority, population, functional-correctness, or paper claims.

The appropriate repair is an exact, independently reviewed successor specification and machine-enforced staged authority. It does not require a factorial design, paper-level power, or an arm-effect estimate for the bounded feasibility assay.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose promising one ratification plus automatic A/B1/B2/B3/C gates is already sufficient to release the program.

positions.position: One exact ratification may authorize the complete conditional A-through-C ladder, with gates automatic inside that scope.

One ratification is acceptable only when exact requested/forbidden scope, stage states, receipts, review prerequisites, and refusal behavior are bound and machine-enforced; the reviewed bytes lack that contract.

resolution.rationale: The latter is required by AGENTS.md and the intake behavior: a generic human approval plus a global implementation flag cannot prove a stage-specific precondition. This is a release blocker, not a requirement for repeated human prompts.
resolution.selected_position: Rework to a canonical scope proposal and enforceable A/B1/B2/B3/C authority state machine before any implementation release.
resolution.required_change: A successor must enumerate sorted allowed and forbidden operations, bind exact proposal/manifest/receipt/review hashes to every transition, expose no global implementation release, fail closed on absent or failed gate, and require a new change for drift, repair, substitution, tuning, target-informed choice, Stage D, or claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether high-level atomized-field and zero-mask prose suffices to define canonical state, SLEEP inputs, and noninterference.

positions.position: Named packet components, finite operational labels, zero-masked prose, and the visibility matrix make the boundary auditable.

The vocabulary, serializers/parsers, truncation precedence, token masks, notebook projection, principals, directional read/write/influence rights, and prose disposition remain unspecified or contradictory.

resolution.rationale: These choices determine model-visible state, loss-bearing targets, hidden conditioning, and durable channels; they are material specification bytes rather than implementation detail.
resolution.selected_position: Rework to an exact canonical-state, operational-mask, sealed-record-projection, and directional authority contract.
resolution.required_change: Bind finite enums and arguments; canonical serializers/parsers and cap/truncation ordering; field/token masks; explicit stripping or retained zero-mask conditioning for every parsed-prose and NOTE_APPEND field; and an allowlist of distinct assembler, parser, writer, retriever, trainer, publisher, environment, fork, quarantine, and audit principals with separate read, write, derived, and causal-influence rights. Unparsed output must be unreachable from SLEEP; if prose is retained, its conditioning must be expressly allowed and audited.

disagreements.issue: Whether target forks without their systems' common capped ledger/notebook retrieval can support the named whole-system HARNESS-versus-EXPERIENTIAL contrast.

positions.position: Fork quarantine forbids every life retrieval store, while D_HE is presented as the primary matched two-system/whole-harness contrast.
Without common life evidence, HARNESS target forks are fresh-base forks and the contrast is parameter-only experience transport, not two whole systems.

resolution.rationale: The thesis makes capped nonparametric evidence a common whole-system component. Removing it at the target boundary changes the estimand and makes HARNESS life acquisition behavior irrelevant.
resolution.selected_position: Preserve the simple two-system core by mounting each system's capped, target-blind, read-only life-evidence snapshot in its own sterile target forks; adapter-off and binding-shuffled EXPERIENTIAL diagnostics must use the EXPERIENTIAL snapshot.
resolution.required_change: Specify immutable snapshot serialization/caps, per-system provenance, target-blind retrieval allowlist, no writer or return path, reset/quarantine behavior, and equal packet construction. HARNESS uses its HARNESS snapshot; EXPERIENTIAL authentic, null adapter-off, and shuffled forks use the EXPERIENTIAL snapshot. If that cannot be proved, rename D_HE everywhere as a parameter-only transport contrast and prohibit whole-system wording.

disagreements.issue: Whether a non-importing/non-executing static fit gate can certify runtime headroom, denominator, and environment semantics for selected target cells.

positions.position: T05A statically binds exact score semantics and target-blind positive-headroom reports before T06A executes offline semantics.
I_0, I_Oz, valid-state behavior, and runtime headroom require authorized environment execution; target-role assignment also needs its own constructor/sealer authority.

resolution.rationale: Static structure can select a prospective split and rules but cannot manufacture execution-derived score facts. The repair remains pre-model and target-blind; it does not add target-driven selection or science scope.
resolution.selected_position: Keep T05A as static byte/structural selection only and move empirical denominator/headroom and environment-semantic validation to the authorized B2 seal.
resolution.required_change: Define a target-role constructor/sealer distinct from hidden evaluator/reference data; bind first-legal candidate/spare rules before execution; have B2 validate I_0/I_Oz, valid/invalid/terminal semantics, and positive headroom under those frozen rules before model calls; and terminally reject without repair, substitution, or target-informed reselection on any failure.

disagreements.issue: Whether the G formula and an unspecified margin already define score cells and the three Stage-C dispositions without restoring a directional efficacy rule.

positions.position: Frozen score/margin rules yield WIRING_FAILURE, RECIPE_FEASIBLE_DESCRIPTIVE, or INDETERMINATE.
Validity, no-op/STOP/error/cell handling, seed aggregation, and margin mapping are not executable; a contrast-threshold positive label would recreate the prohibited one-realization efficacy claim.

resolution.rationale: A bounded feasibility receipt needs fully deterministic score semantics, but neither powered inference nor a factorial is needed. Feasibility must be integrity/completion based, with contrasts reported descriptively.
resolution.selected_position: Rework to exact score-edge and integrity-disposition goldens; do not condition RECIPE_FEASIBLE_DESCRIPTIVE on D_HE, D_off, or D_shuf exceeding m.
resolution.required_change: Bind reset baseline status, each non-environment operation, all-worsening passes, early STOP/terminal behavior, malformed/invalid/timeout/partial-error classification, prior-best retention, whole-cell indeterminacy, seed aggregation, and all three disposition rules. Make WIRING_FAILURE and INDETERMINATE integrity/receipt outcomes; make RECIPE_FEASIBLE_DESCRIPTIVE completion with required valid integrity receipts; report signed contrasts and any resource observations without inference or promotion.

disagreements.issue: Whether named ratios, quotas, LoRA dimensions, and generic determinism/cold-load language are an executable fixed SLEEP recipe.

positions.position: The declared outcome-filtered recipe, reset AdamW, touches, and determinism tiers are sufficient to gate a fixed-recipe canary.

Row selection, scarcity/fallback, packing, optimizer/update accounting, stack bytes, inference/trainer/canary seeds, repeat order, no-retry behavior, and stochastic cold-load metric remain material variables.

resolution.rationale: A fixed recipe can be modest and need not establish causal correctness or undergo a sweep, but it must be reproducible before B3 or C exposure.
resolution.selected_position: Rework to a byte-bound deterministic compiler/training/seed/receipt specification before release beyond fixtures.
resolution.required_change: Define improvement/recovery endpoints and ties, rho operation, selected successor rule, view scarcity and old/new fallback, ordering/truncation/packing, model/tokenizer/training-stack bytes, optimizer and variable-length 24-touch-to-step accounting, numerical tolerance, per-call inference and trainer seed streams, common-random-number and canary repeat order, no retry/reclassification, and behavioral cold-load statistic/tolerance. Preserve the no-preservation/no-auxiliary writer and forbid tuning, sweep, or target access in B3.

disagreements.issue: How narrowly the protocol must describe its score and two-system result.

positions.position: Stage C is recipe feasibility and calls the two primary identities two on-policy systems.
Instruction-count/environment acceptance is not functional correctness, and a complex two-identity harness cannot localize a contrast to any memory or cognitive component.

resolution.rationale: The proposal's central claim boundary is right but needs literal report language so valid/official outcome is not read as correctness and two-system is not read as a simple component comparison.
resolution.selected_position: Retain exactly two on-policy identities and the narrow feasibility scope; require explicit limitation labels in every future receipt/report.
resolution.required_change: State that G is an interface-level IR instruction-count trajectory under the declared environment, not program functional correctness; state that any contrast is for one complex whole-harness recipe and has no component attribution; retain Stage-D-only requirements for functional controls, replication, stronger transports, and comparative claims.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The cited intake/global-authority gap is a release blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add the exact enforceable scoped state machine described in D01 before any release.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Packet and mask bytes determine behavior and cannot be deferred past execution gates.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the canonical packet, finite vocabulary, serializers, truncation, and masks before B2/B3/C.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Mask-zero is not absence of conditioning and the notebook/SLEEP path is contradictory.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind an exact prose/notebook projection and forbid unparsed-output ingress.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The existing forks do not measure the named matched whole-system contrast.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use each system's read-only capped target-blind snapshot, with EXPERIENTIAL's snapshot for authentic/off/shuffle diagnostics.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Static inspection cannot prove runtime headroom or semantics.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Separate static construction from authorized B2 runtime seal and role authority.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The score and disposition mapping need exact edge semantics.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add edge-case goldens and integrity-based, non-directional disposition rules.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The named recipe lacks executable selection and update semantics.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind all compiler, stack, packing, optimizer, and receipt details before B3/C.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A single visibility label cannot establish directional authority or causal influence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace composites and implicit semantics with directional per-principal allowlists.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Finite seed and repeat receipts are needed for reproducibility, not power.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind seed streams, repeats, no-retry policy, and cold-load tolerance metric.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The limitation is material to wording but does not block the limited interface feasibility assay.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Label environment/score validity as non-functional-correctness in reports.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Two on-policy identities are valid, but their elaborate recipe has no component-localizing claim.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep the two-system wording and prohibit component causal attribution; no factorial is required.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A contrast threshold for a positive Stage-C label would violate the settled noninferential boundary.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make feasibility completion/integrity based and report signed diagnostics without margin-driven promotion.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: One ratification is valid only under an exact, enforceable scoped ladder.
Keep the no-preservation writer; do not add a control arm or reintroduce its confound.
Stage C remains a bounded feasibility report irrespective of the required rework.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain, but a successor must supply the currently absent normative packet, serializer, vocabulary, truncation, and mask bytes.
Retain, but it cannot pass until exact writer, prose projection, stack, and update-accounting semantics are bound.
Retain with exact source-snapshot, reset, seed, and cold-load receipt definitions in the successor.
Retain, but directional reader/writer/influence allowlists and snapshot fork parity must be added.
Retain only as a static byte/structural gate; execution-derived headroom and denominator facts move to the existing T06A stage.
Retain and make it the exact pre-model B2 semantic/headroom seal under frozen selection rules.
Retain with exact no-tuning recipe, seed/repeat receipt, and non-directional feasibility semantics.
Retain once snapshots make it a true whole-system contrast and integrity, not contrast magnitude, controls the label.
Retain with the EXPERIENTIAL read-only snapshot for both diagnostics and exact semantic derangement rules.
Retain as a transport-limitation audit; it cannot silently claim absent controls are covered.
Retain the separate Stage-D change, independent review, and human-authority boundary.
Retain, but it must test a real canonical scope proposal and machine-enforced per-stage state/receipt transitions.
